name: Loamcap
description: It came up in the dark under a hollow log and has not hurried since. Loamcap hears the ground the way other creatures hear a room — rain three fields off, a mole going home, the particular crunch of somebody trying not to wake anyone. It will know what tomorrow is doing before tonight is over, and it will not mention it.
babyDescription: A pale button pushing up through the leaf litter, already leaning toward a sound.
teenDescription: The cap has opened and the skirt has come down. It can hold perfectly still for a whole afternoon now, and does.
adultDescription: A broad, quiet cap that knows what tomorrow is going to do and keeps it to itself.
